errors.text: The predicted single-phase or BCC-dominant structure contradicts the target result of an approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC mixed structure.
The claimed Ti-driven HCP precipitation mechanism and its suppression at 1000°C are not supported by evidence specific to CoCrFeNiTi.
The cited stacking-fault-energy evidence concerns CoCrFeMnNi and FCC-to-HCP behavior, so it does not validate a milling-induced FCC-to-BCC transition in CoCrFeNiTi.
The hypothesis omits the quantitative target outcomes of approximately 675 HV hardness, 1894 MPa compressive strength, and density above 6.5 g/cm³.
